title: Watchmen
description: The film is set in a parallel reality, in 1985 America. In this world, superheroes have become part of everyday life, and the Doomsday Clock, frozen at five minutes to midnight, counts down to a clash between the world's leading powers. After the murder of one of his former colleagues, Rorschach—a superhero who never takes off his mask—is determined to carry out lynchings.He begins investigating a conspiracy designed to destroy or discredit all superheroes, past and present. He gathers his allies—a retired legion of crime fighters—but only one possesses true power. Gradually, Rorschach realizes the terrifying scope of the conspiracy, linked to the heroes' shared past and threatening catastrophic consequences for the future. They guard our peace, but who will protect us from the Watchmen?

title: 300: Rise of an Empire
description: After defeating King Leonidas, the Persian army led by Xerxes marches south. They encounter the Athenian fleet under Admiral Themistocles. The opponents are unequal, and Themistocles is forced to ally with Sparta, the Athenian state's sworn enemy. Only by uniting do the warring city-states have a chance of opposing the mighty Xerxes.
The story of the bloody Battle of Thermopylae in 480 BC, in which three hundred brave Spartans, led by King Leonidas, blocked the path of the thousands-strong army of the Persian King Xerxes.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: An army of genetically modified apes faces a new challenge: they are forced into a deadly battle with a human army led by a ruthless colonel. After suffering unimaginable losses among his warriors, the ape leader, Caesar, begins a personal struggle with his dark instincts and seeks revenge for his entire species. Ultimately, he and the colonel must face off in an epic battle that will determine who will rule the Earth—humans or apes.

title: Avengers: Endgame encore
description: Avengers Endgame encore - will be re-released in theaters on September 25, 2026, under the title Avengers Endgame: Encore, in anticipation of the sequel Avengers Doomsday releasing in December 2026.

title: Breaking Bad
description: High school chemistry teacher Walter White discovers he has lung cancer. Given his family's precarious financial situation and his future prospects, Walter decides to start producing methamphetamine. To do this, he recruits his former student, Jesse Pinkman, who was once expelled from school with White's active assistance. Pinkman was cooking meth himself, but the day before, during a DEA raid, he lost his partner and the lab.

title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
description: Fearing that the actions of a god-like superhero will remain unchecked, Gotham City's formidable and powerful vigilante challenges Metropolis's most revered savior, while the rest of the world debates what kind of hero it truly needs. And while Batman and Superman remain at war, a new threat arises, putting humanity in the greatest peril it has ever faced.

title: The Boys
description: Superheroes are the real stars. Everyone knows them and adores them. But behind the perfect façade lies a dark world of drugs and sex, and most of these heroes aren't exactly the nicest people in real life. Opposing them is a group unofficially known as 'The Boys.'

title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
description: The story of what happens when a detective who doesn't take anything seriously gets a new boss who wants him to grow and respect his position.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
description: Wade Wilson is taken in by Time Change Management, forcing him to revert to his alter ego Deadpool and change history with the help of Wolverine.

title: The Walking Dead
description: Wade Wilson is taken in by Time Change Management, forcing him to revert to his alter ego Deadpool and change history with the help of Wolverine.

title: Deadpool
description: Wade Wilson is a mercenary. A byproduct of the military's Weapon X program, Wilson has acquired incredible strength, agility, and healing abilities. But at a terrible cost: his cellular structure is constantly shifting, and his sanity is questionable. All Wilson wants is to stay afloat in the social cesspool. But the current is too fast.

title: Deadpool 2
description: The one and only Merc with a Mouth is back! Bigger, more destructive, and even more bare-assed than ever! When a super-soldier bursts into his life on a murderous mission, Deadpool is forced to reflect on friendship, family, and what it truly means to be a hero, all while kicking 50 shades of ass. Because sometimes, to do good, you have to do dirty.

title: Django Unchained
description: Schultz is an eccentric bounty hunter who tracks down and shoots the most dangerous criminals. He frees a slave named Django because he can help him find three bandits. Django knows these guys by sight; he has a score to settle with them.

title: Reservoir Dogs
description: It should have been the perfect crime. Planning to rob a jewelry store, crime boss Joe Cabot assembled six experienced criminals, complete strangers to each other. But from the very beginning, everything went wrong, and the routine robbery turned into a bloodbath.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
description: The Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, Wakandans, and the New Avengers unite to confront Doctor Doom.

title: Due Date
description: Peter is about to become a father and is on the verge of a nervous breakdown. And it doesn't help that he has to undertake an entire journey, accompanied by an aspiring actor, to get home in time for the birth of his own child.

title: The Hateful Eight
description: The United States after the Civil War. Legendary bounty hunter John Ruth, nicknamed 'The Hangman,' is escorting a prisoner. Along the way, several other travelers join them. A snowstorm forces the group to seek shelter in a remote store, where a rather motley group has already settled in: a Confederate general, a Mexican, a cowboy... And one of them is not who he claims to be.

title: Friends
description: Six friends – Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross – live next door to each other, kill time together, share secrets and sometimes fall deeply in love.

title: Game of Thrones
description: The time of prosperity is drawing to a close, and the summer that lasted nearly a decade is fading. Conspiracies are brewing around the Iron Throne, the seat of power in the Seven Kingdoms, and in these difficult times, the king decides to seek the support of his childhood friend, Eddard Stark. In a world where everyone—from king to mercenary—strives for power, weaves intrigues, and is ready to stab someone in the back, there is room for nobility, compassion, and love. Meanwhile, no one notices the awakening of the darkness of legend far in the North—and only the Wall protects the living south of it.

title: Grown Ups
description: Five childhood friends reunite after 30 years at a summer house by the lake for Independence Day weekend. They are there with their families to honor the memory of their high school basketball coach and celebrate the thirtieth anniversary of the championship they won together.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: Intrepid traveler Peter Quill comes into possession of a mysterious artifact belonging to the powerful and ruthless villain Ronan, who is plotting to take over the universe. Peter finds himself at the center of an intergalactic hunt, where he is the hunted. The only way to save his life is to team up with a quartet of reclusive outcasts: the belligerent raccoon Rocket, the tree-human Groot, the deadly Gamora, and the vengeful Drax, also known as the Destroyer. When Quill realizes the power of the stolen artifact and the danger it poses to the universe, the loner will do anything to rally these unlikely allies for a decisive battle for the fate of the galaxy.

title: The Hangover Part III
description: No wedding this time. No bachelor party. It seems like what could possibly go wrong? But when the Wolf Pack hits the road, all bets are off.

title: Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood
description: It's 1969, and Hollywood's golden age is over. Renowned actor Rick Dalton and his stunt double, Cliff Booth, are trying to find their place in the rapidly changing world of film.

title: Inglourious Basterds
description: World War II. In German-occupied France, a group of Jewish American soldiers strikes fear into the Nazis by brutally murdering and scalping soldiers.

title: John Wick: Chapter 4
description: Leaving a trail of corpses in his wake, John Wick continues to evade assassins of all kinds, and now the hunt for him is led by a young and ambitious member of the Board named Marquis. Two managers of the Continental Hotels in New York and Osaka, who decided to help the wayward killer out of old friendship, have already paid dearly for it, but John suddenly discovers a way out of this seemingly hopeless situation.

title: Joker
description: Gotham, early 1980s. Comedian Arthur Fleck lives with his ailing mother, who has taught him since childhood to 'walk with a smile.' Trying to bring goodness into the world and bring joy, Arthur encounters human cruelty and gradually comes to the conclusion that the world will receive from him not a kind smile, but the smirk of the villainous Joker.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
description: A pregnant hitwoman nicknamed Black Mamba is shot by a man named Bill during her wedding. But the woman's head turns out to be strong—after four years in a coma, the ex-bride awakens. She's burning with desire to find the traitors. Now, only merciless revenge will soothe Black Mamba's heart, and she begins killing off the members of Bill's gang one by one, deciding to save the leader for last.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
description: Having killed two members of the gang, the Bride is only halfway to her goal. Now it's Bud and Ellie Driver's turn. Two more dangerous steps before the final confrontation, in which she must kill Bill.

title: Zack Snyder's Justice League
description: Inspired by Superman's self-sacrifice, Bruce Wayne rediscovers his faith in humanity. He enlists the help of a new ally, Diana Prince, to battle an even more powerful foe. Batman and Wonder Woman recruit a team of superhumans to combat the awakened threat.

title: Life of Pi
description: This is the story of the son of an Indian zoo owner, a boy named Pi. He explores the world, learns to stand up for his principles, seeks his own path to God, living by the canons of three faiths, and falls in love... But fate forces his family to emigrate. Halfway between India and Canada, the ship is wrecked, and Pi is left in a lifeboat with a Bengal tiger, a hyena, a zebra, and an orangutan. All around lies the boundless expanse of water, and ahead lies the unknown...

title: Logan
description: In the near future, a world-weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X, who is hiding near the Mexican border. But Logan can no longer hide his past when he encounters a young mutant haunted by dark forces.

title: The Last of Us
description: In late September 2003, a massive Cordyceps outbreak occurred across the planet. Previously a parasite only on insects, the fungus adapted to survive in the human body, completely dominating the host's will and altering their appearance. On the very first day, Joel, a construction worker at the epicenter of the pandemic, suffered an irreparable loss. Twenty years later, Joel is living in the Boston Quarantine Zone, which is under strict control of the Federal Disaster Management Agency, and he and his girlfriend, Tess, are trying to get a car battery so they can search for his brother in another state. Fate brings him together with a wounded rebel leader, who promises the car and battery if Joel and Tess deliver the wayward 14-year-old orphan Ellie to a squad of fellow soldiers waiting for her outside the quarantine zone.

title: MobLand
description: London. Two powerful crime families, the Harrigans and the Stevensons, are waging a power struggle, avoiding direct confrontation. But this uneasy truce could be disrupted by the disappearance of Tommy, the son of the Stevenson clan's leader, who was last seen at a nightclub with Eddie Harrigan. The Harrigan clan's leader entrusts Harry De Souza, a seasoned 'problem solver,' to sort out the situation.

title: Man of Steel
description: Clark Kent (Kal-El) is a young man who feels like an outsider due to his incredible powers. Many years ago, he was sent to Earth from the advanced planet Krypton, and now he wonders: why? Raised by his adoptive parents, Martha and Jonathan Kent, Clark knows that possessing superpowers means making difficult decisions. But when humanity most needs stability, it comes under attack. Will he be able to restore the world, or will he use his powers to destroy it completely?

title: Neighbors
description: As we all know, there are two types of men: single and deeply married. The former are young, muscular, and like a magnet for blondes and rowdy friends. The latter live at home, raise children, and devour TV series. Their paths usually don't cross. But when they become neighbors, the men go on the warpath.

title: Violent Night 2
description: Santa is back at it again, but this time he's in far from his best shape: stripped of his magic, exiled from the North Pole, and disillusioned with Christmas, he finds himself stuck in the Silver Bell Mall. When a ruthless gangster begins terrorizing local merchants, Santa is forced to remember why he ever wore a red suit in the first place. And to deal with this new threat, he'll need the help of someone no villain should mess with—Mrs. Claus.

title: The Penguin
description: After the death of mob boss Carmine Falcone, his right-hand man, Oswald Cobblepot, aka the Penguin, decides he is entitled to take over. But Falcone leaves behind a daughter, Sofia, who is unwilling to give up her father's criminal legacy. A bloody battle for power erupts in Gotham's criminal underworld.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Two gangsters, Vincent Vega and Jules Winfield, engage in philosophical conversations between fights and dealing with debtors of crime boss Marsellus Wallace. In the first story, Vincent spends an unforgettable evening with Marsellus's wife, Mia. In the second, Marsellus buys boxer Butch Coolidge to throw a fight. In the third story, Vincent and Jules find themselves in trouble through a freak accident.

title: Rome
description: The series begins in 52 BC, when Gaius Julius Caesar conquers Gaul after an eight-year war and prepares to return to Rome. Caesar's niece, Atia, anxiously awaits his return, and the patricians are in despair—they fear that Caesar's return will upset the established status quo and that the prosperity they had built at the expense of the plebs will be undermined. In the Senate, the leaders of the patrician party convince Caesar's old friend, Pompey the Great, that Caesar has become a threat to Rome's prosperity. Meanwhile, two hapless legionaries, Lucius Varenus and Titus Pullo, are plotting a gamble that, if successful, will significantly increase their prosperity. The closer Caesar's legions advance toward Rome, the more tensions rise between soldiers and civilians, and the closer to a climax a conflict that will forever change history...

title: Signs
description: Farmer Graham Hess's life has never been blessed with surprising events or occurrences. Until the day he discovered his cornfield covered in incomprehensible, gigantic markings made of crushed stalks. Residents of the small Pennsylvania town are trying to find a solution to this phenomenon. But no one is more passionate about finding it than the farmer himself, as the fantastic events unfolding in his field challenge everything he knows and believes in this world. Hess begins a personal investigation, unaware of the unimaginable answers he will receive.

title: Sin City
description: Sin City is a crime den. The police are corrupt, and the streets are deadly. Yet, one resident tries to find his girlfriend's killer. Another, a photographer, accidentally witnesses the murder of a police officer and tries to cover up the crime.

title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
description: In the dark alleys of Sin City, Dwight plans brutal revenge on the woman named Ava Lord who betrayed him, while Nancy tries to come to terms with the death of Detective Hartigan.

title: Street Fighter
description: Street fighters Ryu and Ken meet again and find themselves drawn into the world of martial arts when the mysterious Chun-Li invites them to participate in the new World Warrior tournament. However, behind the spectacular fights lies a dangerous conspiracy that forces the fighters to confront each other and also face demons from their pasts.

title: Troy
description: 1193 BC. Paris has stolen the beautiful Helen, wife of King Menelaus of Sparta. His brother, King Agamemnon, intercedes for Menelaus's honor. His army, led by Achilles, approaches Troy and takes the city in a bloody siege that lasts ten long years... Two worlds will war for honor and power. Thousands will die for glory. And for love, a nation will burn to the ground.

title: Tulsa King
description: Convicted New York mobster Dwight 'The General' Manfredi is released after a quarter-century. His boss sends him to the wilderness of Tulsa, Oklahoma, to organize a criminal network there. The General takes the matter seriously and begins building a new criminal empire.

title: Vikings
description: The story of Ragnar's Viking company. He rose up to become king of the Viking tribes. Norse legend holds that he was a direct descendant of Odin, the god of war and warriors.

title: Kong: Skull Island
description: The year is 1973. A team of scientists, military personnel, and adventurers find themselves on an unknown island in the Pacific Ocean. They invade the domain of the mighty Kong, thus unleashing a battle between man and nature. The research mission soon turns into a game of survival, and its participants are forced to literally hack their way to safety.

title: Godzilla vs. Kong
description: Kong and a group of scientists embark on a perilous journey in search of the giant's home. Among them is a girl named Jiya, the only one who can communicate with Kong. Suddenly, they encounter an enraged Godzilla, destroying everything in his path. The battle between the two titans, provoked by unknown forces, is only a small part of the mystery hidden deep within the Earth.

title: Tomb Raider
description: Lara Croft is the highly independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who disappeared when she was just a teenager. Now twenty-one, she lives an aimless life as a courier, cruising the clogged streets of East London on her motorcycle. Determined to make her own way, she refuses to assume control of her father's global empire, just as categorically rejecting the idea that he is truly missing. Advised to accept this fact and move on after seven years of fruitless searching, Lara no longer understands what compels her to unravel the circumstances of his mysterious disappearance.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
description: Having run out of luck, Captain Jack Sparrow finds himself hunted by his old nemesis, the dreaded Captain Salazar, and his undead. They have just escaped the Devil's Triangle and are determined to destroy all pirates, including Jack. Only a powerful artifact—Poseidon's Trident—can save him, granting him complete control of the seas.
